gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'The application' = the act or form of applying; 'applicant' = the person.
